findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: tax_harvest · Public sink: tax_gains, tax_form_8949, tax_schedule_3, tax_harvest, tax_import · Destructive: tax_import.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: tax_harvest · Public sink: tax_gains, tax_form_8949, tax_schedule_3, tax_harvest, tax_import · Destructive: tax_import

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
